notes.description:
KONUM: Jaww, Southern Governorate, Bahrain. İrtifa: 11 m.
YAKIN ÇEVRE: Market: Nejoom Jaw Cold Store (3,4 km), South Lightning Contracting (3,4 km). Akaryakıt: وادي حيان (3,9 km). Sağlık: Serene Psychiatry Hospital (4,0 km). Yerleşim: المحافظة الجنوبية (3,2 km), جو (3,4 km). Zirve: جبل الدخان (6,0 km), جبل الدخان (6,1 km). Görülecek: شجرة الحياة (514 m), ali (1,3 km), hasanain (4,2 km).
DOĞA (çevredeki gözlem kayıtları, bilimsel ad): Kuşlar: Galerida cristata (tepeli toygar), Spilopelia senegalensis (Küçük Kumru), Passer domesticus (Bayağı Serçe), Streptopelia decaocto (kumru), Columba livia (Kaya Güvercini). Bitkiler: Prosopis cineraria, Prosopis juliflora, Heliotropium bacciferum, Tetraena hamiensis, Sesuvium portulacastrum.
ÇEVRE BİLGİSİ (Wikipedia, Tree of Life (Bahrain), 517 m): The Tree of Life (Shajarat-al-Hayat) in Bahrain is a 9.75-metre (32.0 ft) high Prosopis juliflora tree that is over 400 years old. It is on a hill in a barren area of the Arabian Desert, approximately 6 kilometers (3.7 mi) from Jebel Dukhan, the highest point in Bahrain, and 40 kilometers (25 mi) fr
